C0451.title: Nanchang County Public Security Bureau Solves Alipay Theft Case: Online Acquaintance Transfers ¥79,000
C0451.summary: In August 2024, the Lian Tang Criminal Investigation Unit of the Nanchang County Public Security Bureau cracked a case involving unauthorized Alipay transfers. The victim, Li Mouyan, reported that an online acquaintance, Wang Moushe, secretly transferred ¥79,000 from her Alipay account without her consent on August 9, 2024.
